svg.aria-label: Sketch: a supermarket aisle in one-point perspective, tall shelves of jars and boxes converging on both sides toward the far end of the store under strips of ceiling light. In the middle foreground a shopper seen from behind, in a light jacket, rests both hands on the handle of a wire cart holding a few bags; the head is turned toward the left-hand shelves and no face is shown. The polished floor carries faint reflections of the lights. Drawn after an NBC News photograph used with its report on the September consumer price index.
